page_title: BET 3-0 OVI | Betis v Oviedo 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' That's it for today, Adrian Cordero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
89' A pass by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
88' Hector Bellerin (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
87' Hector Bellerin (Betis) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
86' Hector Bellerin (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
85' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
83' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
83' David Costas (Real Oviedo) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece.
82' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is able to continue to play.
82' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
81' A substitution has been made. Cucho Hernandez is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
81' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to make a change. Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) replaces Federico Vinas.
81' Substitution. Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) replaces Nacho Vidal.
80' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
79' PENALTY APPEAL by Oviedo, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

76' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Aaron Escandell thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
75' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
73' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
71' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
71' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso is replaced by Isco (Betis).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nelson Deossa (Betis) comes onto the pitch for Sofyan Amrabat.

69' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alvaro Valles to get hold of the ball.
68' The attendance for today's match is 57578.
67' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
64' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Thiago Fernandez will be replaced by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo).
64' Substitution. Santiago Colombatto did his best and is replaced by Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo).
63' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar.
63' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) will take the free kick.
63' It will be a substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Pablo Fornals walks off.
62' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Antony and he is replaced by Marc Roca (Betis).
62' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Adrian Cordero blows for a foul.
60' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles was alert and made a comfortable save.

58' 3 - 0 Abde Ezzalzouli is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the right post to make the score 3:0.
58' The resulting corner from Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) is cleared.
58' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Oviedo.

57' A lofted cross from Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Oviedo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Fonseca.
54' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Oviedo due to an offside in the build-up play.
54' Wait! Referee Adrian Cordero has indicated he is going to review the Oviedo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' Goal! Thiago Fernandez gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
52' Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
49' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero starts the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Antony (Betis) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
45+4' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
45+4' 3:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
45+3' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the right post.
45+3' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Antony, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis), who beats Aaron Escandell with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

44' Aaron Escandell makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Antony (Betis) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
43' Pablo Fornals (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Betis.
42' Adrian Cordero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Diego Llorente (Betis).
40' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
39' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Oviedo.
38' PENALTY APPEAL after Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
38' The ball is cleared after Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Oviedo.
38' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
36' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is caught offside!
34' Poor challenge! Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) is penalised for tripping and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle.
33' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

32' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Aaron Escandell. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
31' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Betis play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.
31' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
29' The cross into the penalty area from Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
28' Dangerous play by Pablo Fornals (Betis). Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
24' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

24' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Adrian Cordero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
22' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
21' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
20' A dangerous looking corner kick from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is cleared to safety by the defence.
20' Hector Bellerin (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Ball possession – 59:41.
16' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
15' A clumsy foul by Pablo Fornals (Betis) and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Oviedo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
14' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
14' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
12' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
10' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

10' The game is pretty dull as Betis are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.

9' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
6' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes it short.
6' Hector Bellerin (Betis) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
4' Referee Adrian Cordero sees the trip by David Costas (Real Oviedo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

3' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
3' Oviedo couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alvaro Valles (Betis) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
2' Natan (Betis) jumps into a tackle and Adrian Cordero signals a foul. Oviedo are awarded the free kick.
1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.

1' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Oviedo will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Adrian Cordero.
